caseName: Chicago, Burlington & Quincy Railroad v. Wolfe
caseNameFull: Chicago, Burlington and Quincy Railroad Company, in Error v. Kate G. Wolfe, Administratrix, etc.
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Nebraska-
attorneys: Mr. J. W. Deweese and Mr. Charles F. Manderson for the plaintiff in error. Mr. T. J. Mahoney for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment’ affirmed with costs, on the authority of Chicago, Rock Island &c. Railroad Company v. Zernecke, 183 U. S. 582.
